q: The variational principle for topological entropy states:
opts: h_top(T) = sup over all invariant measures of h_μ(T)
h_top(T) = inf over all invariant measures of h_μ(T)
h_top(T) = h_μ(T) for any ergodic μ
h_top(T) equals the Hausdorff dimension of X
exp: The variational principle: topological entropy equals the supremum of measure-theoretic entropies over all invariant probability measures. Measures achieving this supremum are called measures of maximal entropy.
